<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex71032026-10-1510-43-53" status="unreviewed">  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs>
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="90b2"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">slob dpon</rs> ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3786">rngog</rs> ltar yin te 'dir e de'i rgyud lha skye ba'i khyad par gsuM dang ldan pa cig dngos su bstan pas ldog a sgo nas khyad par bral ba'i nyan thos kyi rgyud la skye ma'i skyea ba dang mtshan nyid mtshungs pa cig mtshan nas bstan pa yin te | mdo nas rgyal sbyin gyi spe de chan po'i yuM gang lags zhes nus pa'i lan du go du shi ka be de chen po'i yum ni '
               <lb edRef="inst:5176" n="90b3"/> yin te rnam pa <expan>thams cad</expan> makhyen pasi yid la bya bas mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs mi rtag par yid pa bya'o zhes khyad par gsum dang ldan par gsungs ste 'bre'i zhib sha de dag gis ci la yang mi phan no gsung ngo |
               
               phyis 'gyur nas zhang gi ltar byung ngo || |  </seg></TEI>
